error.title: Instance frame range does not cover full workfile range
error.description:
## Instance frame range issue
The render instance **{instance_label}** has layers with extending post-behavior (repeat, pingpong, or hold) but its **frame_end** does not cover the full workfile frame range.
- Current frame_end: **{current_frame_end}** - Expected frame_end: **{expected_frame_end}** (scene marks: {scene_mark_in}\u2013{scene_mark_out})
### How to fix?
Use the **Repair** button to expand the instance frame_end to match the scene mark-out, or adjust the frame range manually in the render creator.
Reset publishing after making changes.
